Elephant Tranquilization Operation Continues for Sixth Day

A tranquilization operation for an elephant, known as Kabra, has been ongoing for six days. The elephant has reportedly killed 19 people and its behavior has changed after joining a herd of 17 elephants. Previous rescue attempts over five days were unsuccessful.
